_comment: Path risk rules. Levels and triggers follow the original Shadow AI skill (High / Medium / Low / None). The numeric cut-offs marked proposal are Fluency proposals: the original text says only 'many hosts' and 'broad use'.

saas.high: any AI app with a content-read scope plus offline_access and no verified publisher (original rule)
saas.medium: user-consented AI apps that are not first-party, or an AI app from an unverified third-party publisher, or a Tier 1 service (original rule)
saas.low: only first-party, enterprise-tier or verified AI apps

endpoint.note: high: local model runners on 5 or more hosts (proposal); medium: 1 to 4 hosts, or non-first-party AI desktop apps on 10% or more of inventoried hosts (proposal); low: smaller desktop footprint; none: nothing found. First-party Microsoft Copilot is not counted.

detection.medium: no enabled EventWatch rule that is specific to AI use (original: 'no AI detection coverage' is Medium)

network.note: path 2 reads the archived Fortigate_Traffic_Activity_Report (FortiGate, by application name) and Zscaler_Web_Activity_Report (by application and domain). Cut-offs are Fluency proposals; the original skill defined no network rule.
network.high: allowed GenAI traffic to a non-first-party service from 25 or more internal sources on the busiest day (proposal)
network.medium: any allowed GenAI traffic to a non-first-party service (proposal)
network.low: GenAI traffic that was all blocked, or only first-party (Microsoft Copilot)
network.none: application names are recorded and no GenAI application appears
network.no_data: no archived FortiGate day, no traffic, or no application names (Application Control off): not assessed, never clean

data.high: Microsoft 365 Copilot DLP policy matches that were not enforced (original rule: DLP hits coinciding with AI use, adapted to the one AI signal the DLP report carries)
data.medium: Copilot policy matches that were enforced, or DLP matches where not all rules enforce
data.low: matches, all enforced, none on the Copilot policy
data.no_data: no DLP evidence, or zero matches (cannot separate no policy from no sensitive data moved)
data.informational: override settings, false-positive reports, policy locations and sharing volume are shown as metrics and low findings; they do not change the path risk
